# Version 3.119.4
> **Broader platforms and safer streams** · Released May 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.4)

> **Supersedes [3.119.3](3.119.3.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.4 adds GTK 4 views and expands native platform coverage while improving stream and loading reliability. Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets join the package set. Android view reattachment, tvOS simulator linking, reflection-disabled AOT, and Windows CPU-only startup receive fixes, alongside refreshed native dependencies.

## Breaking Changes

- **Update platform-specific .NET targets** — Platform libraries move to .NET 9 and .NET 10 target sets. Update platform-specific consumers to a compatible target and workload; this does not remove the existing net462 and .NET Standard compatibility targets for core libraries. .NET Framework 4.8 is added and recommended for desktop applications. ([#3514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3514), [#3631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3631))
- **Do not use the generated Blazor _Imports type as a component** — The generated SkiaSharp.Views.Blazor._Imports type no longer derives from ComponentBase or implements its component interfaces. Remove code that instantiates or treats that generated imports type as a Blazor component.

## Platform

- **GTK 4 drawing views** — Adds SkiaSharp.Views.Gtk4 with SKDrawingArea and GTK/Skia geometry and color conversions using GirCore bindings. A follow-up fix prevents Cairo snapshot assertions during repeated redraws. ([#3527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3527), [#3562](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3562))
- **Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets** — Adds linux-bionic x64 and arm64 assets for SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp without fontconfig dependencies. Tizen gains x64 and arm64 assets alongside its existing 32-bit targets. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Independent managed-stream duplicates** — SKManagedStream duplicates and forks use a cached, ref-counted SKData snapshot. The original remains readable, multiple duplicates are allowed, and disposing the parent can close the .NET stream without invalidating the duplicates. Non-seekable streams return null for duplicate and fork requests. ([#3589](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3589))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native loading on Linux and Windows** — Fixes Linux ARM64 fontconfig loading and LoongArch native linkage. Windows CPU-only rendering can load without Direct3D 12 components, and ANGLE statically links its C runtime to avoid requiring the VC++ Redistributable. ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494), [#3629](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3629), [#3648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3648), [#3633](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3633), [#3510](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3510))
- **Android reattachment and tvOS simulator linking** — MAUI Android SKGLView redraws after returning to a tab or page at the same size. tvOS packages and native references distinguish simulator frameworks from device frameworks, preventing simulator link failures. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#3561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3561), [#3563](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3563))
- **Reflection-disabled AOT initialization** — SKBlender initializes blend modes without reflection, avoiding TypeInitializationException when IlcDisableReflection=true. ([#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485))

## Security

- **Native dependency refresh and hardening** — Updates libpng to 1.6.58, libwebp to 1.6.0, Brotli to 1.2.0, and libexpat to 2.7.3. Native SkiaSharp builds also enable Spectre mitigation flags on Windows and Linux. — ❤️ [@sshumakov](https://github.com/sshumakov) ([#3723](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3723), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3458](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3458), [#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5

HarfBuzzSharp adds Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets and separates tvOS simulator assets from device frameworks. Its platform target sets move with the .NET 9/10 update; the 8.3.1.5 package revision is not a native engine upgrade.

## Preview 1 (April 22, 2026)

Added GTK 4 views, Linux Bionic assets, and 64-bit Tizen support. Introduced independent managed-stream snapshots and fixed Android view reattachment, tvOS simulator linking, and Windows startup without Direct3D 12.
